def design(feats):
    X = np.asarray(feats.x, float); y = np.asarray(feats.y, float); n, p = X.shape
    ids = list(feats.ids); labs = sorted(set(feats.stratum)); SKIP = 0.9
    S = np.column_stack([np.ones(n)] + [np.array([s == l for s in feats.stratum], float) for l in labs[1:]])
    R = np.nan_to_num(np.corrcoef(X.T))
    def fit(Z):
        A = np.column_stack([S, Z]) if Z is not None else S
        b = np.zeros(A.shape[1])
        for _ in range(30):
            pr = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(A @ b, -30, 30)))
            H = A.T @ (A * (pr * (1 - pr))[:, None]) + 1e-6 * np.eye(A.shape[1])
            st = np.linalg.solve(H, A.T @ (y - pr)); b += st
            if np.abs(st).max() < 1e-7: break
        pr = np.clip(1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(A @ b, -30, 30))), 1e-12, 1 - 1e-12)
        return float(np.sum(y * np.log(pr) + (1 - y) * np.log(1 - pr))), pr
    def col(j): return X[:, j[0]] * X[:, j[1]] if isinstance(j, tuple) else X[:, j]
    def M(js): return np.column_stack([col(j) for j in js]) if js else None
    def ll(js): return fit(M(js))[0]
    def gain(base, j): return 2 * (ll(base + [j]) - ll(base))
    sel = []
    while len(sel) < MAX_DRIVERS:
        base = ll(sel); ok = [j for j in range(p) if j not in sel and all(abs(R[j, k]) < SKIP for k in sel)]
        if not ok: break
        lls = {j: ll(sel + [j]) for j in ok}; bj = max(lls, key=lls.get); best = 2 * (lls[bj] - base)
        if stats.chi2.sf(best, 1) > 0.05 / p: break
        cand = [k for k in ok if abs(R[bj, k]) >= 0.6 and lls[k] >= lls[bj] - 2]
        if len(cand) > 1:
            cl = [k for k in ok if abs(R[bj, k]) >= 0.6]
            bj = min(cand, key=lambda k: sum(max(gain(sel + [k], q), 0) for q in cl if q != k))
        sel.append(bj)
    while sel:
        full = ll(sel)
        pv = [stats.chi2.sf(2 * (full - ll([k for k in sel if k != j])), 1) for j in sel]
        w = int(np.argmax(pv))
        if pv[w] <= 0.02 / p: break
        sel.pop(w)
    prods = []; npair = p * (p + 1) // 2
    for _ in range(2):
        base = sel + prods; fp = fit(M(base))[1]; r = y - fp; wv = fp * (1 - fp)
        sc = []
        for a in range(p):
            P = X[:, a:] * X[:, [a]]
            s = (P * r[:, None]).sum(0) ** 2 / ((P ** 2 * wv[:, None]).sum(0) + 1e-9)
            sc += [(s[i], (a, a + i)) for i in range(P.shape[1])]
        sc.sort(reverse=True); bestp, bg = None, 0
        for _, pq in sc[:15]:
            if pq in prods: continue
            ex = [k for k in dict.fromkeys(pq) if k not in sel]
            g = 2 * (ll(base + ex + [pq]) - ll(base + ex))
            if g > bg: bg, bestp = g, pq
        if bestp is None or stats.chi2.sf(bg, 1) > 0.01 / npair / (1 + 4 * len(prods)): break
        prods.append(bestp)
        for k in bestp:
            if k not in sel: sel.append(k)
    drv = list(dict.fromkeys(sel))[:MAX_DRIVERS]
    return Design(drivers=tuple(ids[j] for j in drv), columns=tuple(ids[j] for j in sel),
                  products=tuple((ids[a], ids[b]) for a, b in prods), loadings={})
